Verb plus object in the reader's own terms: they came for tư vấn, not to submit a form. entries.notes: Recompiled 2026-08-25. Two facts the title does not carry: the reply comes back through the details just submitted, and nothing further is required. The second sentence is load-bearing rather than polite — the panel renders SITE.contact.phone/email in a <dl> directly underneath, and without this line that <dl> reads as an instruction to make contact a second time. Deliberately silent on the 24 hours: C035 is stated once, in contact.intro.lead, which sits in the same viewport on desktop; see decisions/success-panel-omits-the-clock for the one-line swap if the requester wants the clock here after all. Dropped with the mailto: `chưa có gì rời máy bạn` (false — the data left the machine, on purpose) and the `ngay bên dưới` fallback (it recovered a mail client that never opened; that failure mode is now contact.form.errorBody). 81 characters against the ~190 the old string spent, in a block with zero measured slack. Sentence two is `không cần làm gì thêm`, not `không cần làm thêm gì`: in Vietnamese `làm thêm` collocates first with working overtime, and the reordering costs nothing.

entries.notes: New field on ContactContent.form, first copy 2026-08-25. Shown when the POST does not return ok, inline beside the still-live submit button, role="alert". State, then two actions (references/product/errors.md) — press the button again, or reach a person. No cause: the component is handed none, and 429, 5xx and a dead network are one state to the reader; naming one would be a guess printed as a fact, and a status code would be PRODUCT_TECHNICAL_LEAKAGE. No apology — `rất tiếc` / `có lỗi xảy ra` are the vi generic-failure patterns and vi.md's error rule is state, then action. `Chưa`, not `Không`: the failure is retryable and the word says so. ENDS ON A COLON BY REQUIREMENT — the component appends `{phone} · {email}` immediately after this string, so a full stop here would strand a phone number as its own sentence. Neither value is retyped into vi.ts; both stay in web/content/site.ts.
